propositions.name: aether_pervaded_by_electrons
propositions.statement: The material system consists of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons.
propositions.quote: the material system as consisting of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons which are to be treated individually

propositions.name: electrons_grouped_into_molecules
propositions.statement: The great majority of electrons are grouped into material molecules.
propositions.quote: some of them free or isolated, but the great majority of them grouped into material molecules

propositions.name: translatory_motion_through_aether
propositions.statement: A material system may have a translatory velocity superposed on its motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: we shall attempt to compare the relative motions of these electrons when they form, or belong to, a material system devoid of translatory motion through the aether, with what it would be when a translatory velocity is superposed

propositions.name: aether_dynamical_equations_ascertained
propositions.statement: The dynamical equations of the free aether have been definitely ascertained from both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity.
propositions.quote: whose dynamical equations have been definitely ascertained in quite independent ways from consideration of both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity

propositions.name: electron_singular_point
propositions.statement: An electron occurs as a singular point in the aether at which the aethereal displacement increases indefinitely.
propositions.quote: An electron e will occur in this analysis as a singular point in the aether, on approaching which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement ( f, g, h ) increases indefinitely

propositions.name: electron_as_strain_nucleus
propositions.statement: The singularity of an electron represents a definite structure, a nucleus of strain in the aether, capable of transference across the aether independently of motion of the aether itself.
propositions.quote: It is assumed that this singularity represents a definite structure, forming a nucleus of strain in the aether, which is capable of transference across that medium independently of motion of the aether itself

propositions.name: strain_carried_with_electron
propositions.statement: The aethereal strain associated with the electron is carried along with the electron in its motion.
propositions.quote: which is associated with the electron and is carried along with the electron in its motion, being as above

propositions.name: electron_energy_concentrated
propositions.statement: The energy of the displacement is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron and not widely diffused.
propositions.quote: the energy of this part of the displacement is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron, and not widely diffused as might at first sight appear

propositions.name: electrons_as_sources_sinks
propositions.statement: Electrons in the effective element of volume are analogous to the sources and sinks in the theory of liquid flow.
propositions.quote: except where there are electrons in the effective element of volume: these are analogous to the so-called sources and sinks in the abstract theory of liquid flow

propositions.name: displacement_integral_equals_electron_quantity
propositions.statement: The integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of a region is equal to the quantity of electrons existing in the region.
propositions.quote: the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of any region, instead of being null, is equal to the quantity Σe of electrons existing in the region

propositions.name: magnetic_induction_no_simple_poles
propositions.statement: The magnetic induction possesses the stream property, but singular points of the nature of simple poles do not exist in its distribution.
propositions.quote: the magnetic induction ( a, b, c ), also possesses the stream property; but singular points in its distribution, of the nature of simple poles, do not exist

propositions.name: electron_motion_rotational_singularity
propositions.statement: The motion of an electron involves a singularity of a rotational type in the magnetic induction, with its nucleus at the moving electron.
propositions.quote: The motion of an electron involves however a singularity in ( a, b, c ), of a rotational type, with its nucleus at the moving electron

propositions.name: orbital_motion_as_magnetic_doublet
propositions.statement: The time-average of the singularity for a rapid steady orbital motion of an electron is equivalent, at distances considerable compared with the dimensions of the orbit, to a magnetic doublet.
propositions.quote: the time-average of this singularity for a very rapid minute steady orbital motion of an electron is analytically equivalent, at distances considerable compared with the dimensions of the orbit, to a magnetic doublet

propositions.name: aether_sensibly_at_rest
propositions.statement: The various parts of the aether are sensibly at rest, so that the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time alone.
propositions.quote: the various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest, so that for example the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time

propositions.name: aether_equations_linear
propositions.statement: The equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear.
propositions.quote: in this respect the equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear

propositions.name: matter_flits_through_stagnant_aether
propositions.statement: The aether is stagnant while the molecules constituting the Earth and other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it.
propositions.quote: The aether is stagnant on this theory, while the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it

propositions.name: aberration_and_doppler_hold
propositions.statement: The law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained, and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good.
propositions.quote: hence the law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained, and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good

propositions.name: terrestrial_optics_unaffected_by_earth_motion
propositions.statement: All purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion.
propositions.quote: it will appear that all purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion

propositions.name: c_single_physical_constant
propositions.statement: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it.
propositions.quote: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it

propositions.name: optical_electrodynamic_equations_equivalent
propositions.statement: The equations of the aether are the same as the equations arrived at earlier in the formulation of the dynamics of optical media.
propositions.quote: they are the same as the equations arrived at by MacCullagh a quarter of a century earlier in his formulation of the dynamics of optical media

propositions.name: electron_permanence_and_mobility
propositions.statement: An electron has permanence and characteristic properties, and free mobility through the aether.
propositions.quote: including therein the permanence and characteristic properties of an electron and its free mobility through the aether

propositions.name: state_determines_future_state
propositions.statement: From a knowledge of the state of the system at any time the state at a later time can be immediately expressed.
propositions.quote: from a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t the state at the time t + δt can be immediately expressed

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_labile
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is quite labile as regards displacement through the aether, its movement not influenced by any inertia or forces except its relation to the aether.
propositions.quote: the nucleus of the electron is quite labile as regards displacement through the aether, in other words that its movement is not influenced by any inertia or forces except such as are the expression of its relation to the aether

propositions.name: electrons_treated_as_points
propositions.statement: The dimensions of the nuclei of electrons are extremely small in comparison with the distances between them, so that it suffices for the theory to consider them as points.
propositions.quote: so long as the actual dimensions of their nuclei are extremely small in comparison with the distances between them, it will suffice for the theory to consider them as points

propositions.name: atoms_only_electric_forces
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, and the only actions between atoms are electric forces.
propositions.quote: in which atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces

propositions.name: atom_as_vortex_ring
propositions.statement: The atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid.
propositions.quote: the atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid

propositions.name: aether_rest_frame_exists
propositions.statement: There are axes at rest in the aether, distinct from axes moving with translatory velocity through the aether.
propositions.quote: changing from axes ( x, y, z ) at rest in the aether to axes (x', y', z') moving with translatory velocity v

propositions.name: correlated_aethereal_system_exists
propositions.statement: For a system referred to axes moving through the aether there exists a correlated aethereal system whose sequence of changes is referred to axes at rest.
propositions.quote: then there exists a correlated aethereal system whose sequence of spontaneous changes referred to axes (x', y', z') at rest are such that its electric and magnetic vectors

propositions.name: electrons_occupy_corresponding_positions
propositions.statement: The electrons in the two systems compared, being situated at the singular points at which the electric displacement ceases to vanish, occupy corresponding positions.
propositions.quote: the electrons in the two systems here compared, being situated at the singular points at which the concentration of the electric displacement ceases to vanish, occupy corresponding positions

propositions.name: electrons_equal_strengths
propositions.statement: The electrons in the two systems are of equal strengths, since very near an electron the values of the displacement vectors are practically those due to it alone.
propositions.quote: these electrons are of equal strengths: for, very near an electron, fixed or moving, the values of ( f, g, h ) and ( a, b, c ) are practically those due to it

propositions.name: electron_strength_invariant_to_first_order
propositions.statement: The strengths of the corresponding electrons in the two systems are the same, to this order of approximation.
propositions.quote: the strengths of the corresponding electrons in the two systems are the same, to this order of approximation

propositions.name: transformation_applies_to_dielectric_media
propositions.statement: The transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether, altering c into the velocity of radiation in that medium.
propositions.quote: the above analytical transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether: we have only to alter c into the velocity of radiation in that medium

propositions.name: moving_polarized_matter_alters_current
propositions.statement: The motion of the polarized dielectric matter alters the mathematical type of the electric current.
propositions.quote: for the motion of the polarized dielectric matter has altered the mathematical type of the electric current

propositions.name: moving_system_identical_equilibrium
propositions.statement: Given any system of electrified bodies at rest in equilibrium under their mutual electric influences and constraints, there is a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints in uniform translatory motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: given any system of electrified bodies at rest, in equilibrium under their mutual electric influences and imposed constraints, there will be a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints, and in uniform translatory motion through the aether

propositions.name: motion_no_first_order_effect_on_distribution
propositions.statement: Uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions to the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation.
propositions.quote: uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned

propositions.name: result_independent_of_molecular_force_theory
propositions.statement: The result that motion does not alter electric distributions is independent of any theory as to the nature of the forces between material molecules, the structure of matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: this result is independent of any theory as to the nature of the forces between material molecules: the structure of the matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether

propositions.name: no_new_forces_for_moving_configuration
propositions.statement: If a configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, the maintenance of the same configuration in a system in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces.
propositions.quote: if any configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, the maintenance of the same configuration as regards the system in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces

propositions.name: electron_singularity_on_any_theory
propositions.statement: The electron taken by itself must be, on any conceivable theory, a simple singularity of the aether whose movements when free and interactions when constrained by matter are traceable through the differential equations of the surrounding free aether.
propositions.quote: must be on any conceivable theory a simple singularity of the aether whose movements when it is free, and interactions with other electrons if it can be constrained by matter, are traceable through the differential equations

propositions.name: displacements_differ_first_order
propositions.statement: Though the fixed and the moving system of electrons are at corresponding instants identical, the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order.
propositions.quote: the fixed and the moving system of electrons of this correlation are at corresponding instants identical, yet the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order
